description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, South Wind Avatar's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
